summary: Exposed knife and items near stove create cut and fire hazards.

hazards.title: Unsecured Countertop Knife
hazards.detail: Large knife resting near counter edge is accessible to children.
fixSteps: Store knife immediately in a secure knife block or locked drawer.
Keep blades away from edges where children can reach them.

hazards.title: Combustible on Stovetop
hazards.detail: Candle jar placed directly on cooktop surface presents a fire risk.
fixSteps: Remove items from the cooktop surface when not cooking.
Store decorative jars away from burners.

hazards.title: Towel Near Heat Source
hazards.detail: Hanging dish towel can catch fire if oven door or burners overheat.
fixSteps: Hang kitchen towels on a hook away from cooking appliances.
Ensure towels never touch hot oven surfaces or range elements.

hazards.title: Unsecured Lower Cabinets
hazards.detail: Base cabinets lack child safety latches for dangerous items.
fixSteps: Install magnetic or spring-loaded child locks on lower cabinets.
Relocate cleaning chemicals or sharp tools to high cabinets.

products.name: Universal Knife Block
products.reason: Safely stores sharp knives out of reach of children.

products.name: Child Safety Cabinet Latches
products.reason: Prevents toddlers from opening lower kitchen cabinets.
